intro: The exact line-up changes depending on animal welfare, temperament and availability.

items.title: Snakes
items.description: A calm, handleable snake is often the star guest, with plenty of time for questions and supervised touching.

items.title: Lizards
items.description: Friendly lizards such as bearded dragons or geckos bring a completely different texture, movement and personality.

items.title: Tortoises & other reptiles
items.description: Where suitable, the line-up may also include a tortoise or another reptile chosen for a safe, relaxed encounter.
